mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqQuotationUnitpriceHistoryPopList*/ SELECT A.REVISION, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.ATOB_DATE, NVL((SELECT ATOB_UNIT_PRICE FROM KEPQTDT B WHERE B.BUYER=A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION=A.REVISION AND B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG='Y' AND B.AGENT_REVISION = (SELECT MAX(C.AGENT_REVISION) FROM KEPQTDT C WHERE C.BUYER=A.BUYER AND C.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND C.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND C.REVISION=A.REVISION )),0) AS ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, A.REJECT_REMARK, A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE, NVL(A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE,0) AS BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, NVL(A.ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE,0) AS ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AS BUYER_NAME , B.CHANGE_DATE , B.UNIT_PRICE , A.DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.ITEM_QTY , A.KEP_DESCRIPTION , A.KEP_SPECIFICATION , A.MAKER_NAME , A.KEP_MAKER_NAME , A.BUYER_ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE , A.IMAGE_KEY AS IMAGE_KEY , DECODE(A.IMAGE_KEY,'',2,3) AS IMAGE_KEY_IMG FROM KEPRQDT A, ICOMCQDT B WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER(+) AND A.CONTRACT_NO = B.CONTRACT_NO(+) AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = B.CONTRACT_SEQ(+) AND B.STATUS(+) <> 'D'

/*selectMasterMpRqQuotationUnitpriceHistoryPopList2*/ SELECT A.AGENT_REVISION, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.AGENT AND STATUS <> 'D') AS AGENT_NAME, A.STOA_DATE, NVL(A.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0) AS STOA_LIST_PRICE , NVL(A.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0) AS STOA_LIST_PRICE2 , A.STOA_REMARK, (SELECT RQ.ATOS_REMARK FROM KEPRQDT RQ WHERE RQ.BUYER = A.BUYER AND RQ.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND RQ.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND RQ.REVISION = A.REVISION) AS ATOS_REMARK, (SELECT RQ.ATOS_REMARK2 FROM KEPRQDT RQ WHERE RQ.BUYER = A.BUYER AND RQ.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND RQ.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND RQ.REVISION = A.REVISION) AS ATOS_REMARK2, SUBSTR(A.ATOS_END_DATE,0,4) ||'/'||SUBSTR(A.ATOS_END_DATE,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.ATOS_END_DATE,7,2) ||' ' ||SUBSTR(NVL(TRIM(A.ATOS_END_TIME),'19'),0,2)||':'||SUBSTR(NVL(TRIM(A.ATOS_END_TIME),'19'),3,2) AS ATOS_END_DATE, NVL(A.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG, 'N') AS BID_SUCCESS_FLAG, A.ATOS_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ATOS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ATOS_DATE2, A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, A.AGENT, A.STATUS, CASE WHEN A.ATOS_END_DATE||A.ATOS_END_TIME < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS END_TIME_FLAG, DECODE(NVL( NVL((SELECT COUNT(QT.AGENT) FROM KEPQTDT QT WHERE QT.BUYER=A.BUYER AND QT.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND QT.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QT.REVISION=A.REVISION AND QT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND QT.AGENT_REVISION = A.AGENT_REVISION GROUP BY QT.BUYER, QT.QUOTATION_NO, QT.QUOTATION_SEQ, QT.REVISION),0) - NVL((SELECT COUNT(B.AGENT) FROM KEPQTDT B WHERE B.BUYER=A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION=A.REVISION AND B.SEL_USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.AGENT_REVISION = A.AGENT_REVISION GROUP BY B.BUYER, B.QUOTATION_NO, B.QUOTATION_SEQ, B.REVISION),0),0), 0, 'Y','N') AS SEND_FLAG, DECODE(A.SEL_USER_ID,NULL,'N','Y') AS AGENT_SEND_FLAG, NVL(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0) AS ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, NVL(A.LEAD_TIME,'0') AS LEAD_TIME , A.DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.ITEM_QTY , CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN A.ATOS_END_DATE||A.ATOS_END_TIME < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) = 'N' AND A.ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END OPEN_FLAG , A.MIN_ORDER_QTY , A.PUR_UNIT_QTY , A.SELLER_AREA , DECODE(A.SELLER_AREA,'','4','5') AS SELLER_AREA_IMG , A.PROCESS_TYPE , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'M034' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.CODE = A.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_NM , A.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY , DECODE(A.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY,'',2,3) AS IMAGE_KEY_IMG , A.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID =A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NM FROM KEPQTDT A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY A.AGENT_REVISION DESC, A.ATOS_END_DATE ASC, A.ATOS_END_TIME ASC

/*selectMasterMpRqQuotationUnitpriceHistoryPopList3*/ SELECT A.BUYER , A.QUOTATION_NO , A.QUOTATION_SEQ , A.REVISION , A.NEGO_SEQ , A.NEGO_PRICE , TO_CHAR(A.NEGO_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS NEGO_DATE , A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE , A.BTOA_NEGO_REMARK , A.CREATE_USER_ID FROM BNTNEGOHISTORY A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} ORDER BY A.NEGO_SEQ DESC
